line: HP ZBook Power 16 G11 A (2025, AMD mobile workstation)
config_name: ZBook Power 16 G11 A — Ryzen 7 PRO 8845HS, NVIDIA RTX 1000 Ada 6GB + Radeon 780M, 32GB DDR5, 512GB SSD, 16" WUXGA 400-nit

specs.storage_type: PCIe Gen4 NVMe M.2 SSD (user-replaceable, second M.2 bay free)
specs.ports: 2x USB4 Type-C, 2x USB-A, HDMI 2.1, RJ45, 3.5mm (SD reader optional by CTO)
specs.keyboard_notes: Backlit spill-resistant keyboard, numeric keypad, PointStick optional

battery.notes: ~83Wh battery; same platform as 1TB twin. Estimate from Ryzen 8845HS efficiency and ZBook Power G10 owner reports.

price.notes: Sale $2,299 (reg $3,013), verified via BBY page config selector 2026-11-24. Includes 3-year HP warranty.

offers.name: HP ZBook Power 16 G11 A 16" Mobile Workstation Business Laptop - AMD Ryzen 7 PRO 8845HS - 32GB DDR5 - 512GB SSD - RTX 1000 Ada - Windows 11 Pro - Grey

praises: ISV-certified RTX 1000 Ada drivers run SolidWorks and Inventor smoothly at this price — no gaming-laptop driver gamble
Both RAM slots and both M.2 bays are user-accessible under one bottom cover — 512GB is just a starting point, add a second drive cheaply
Ryzen 7 PRO 8845HS is cool and efficient — much quieter on office loads than Intel HX workstation competitors
2x USB4 + HDMI 2.1 + RJ45 drives triple-display docked setups without dongles
3-year HP warranty and HP Wolf Security included at a price below most non-workstation laptops
complaints: 16" WUXGA 1920x1200 60Hz panel is the weak point — 400 nits and coarse pixels for a workstation at this price
RTX 1000 Ada 6GB bottlenecks large CAD assemblies and any local LLM work; VRAM fills quickly
512GB fills fast once CAD project caches and Adobe suites are installed (second M.2 bay recommended)
Chassis is thick and heavy (~2.6kg + large brick) compared to ZBook Firefly or EliteBook
Sustained all-core loads throttle the CPU as the Power chassis has lower power limits than ZBook Studio

design_philosophy: ZBook Power is HP's accessible mobile workstation: EliteBook/PRO business platform plus ISV-certified Ada graphics in a serviceable 16" chassis, trading thinness and a premium panel for price, docking breadth, and repairability. This is the floor configuration of the line — same certified GPU and PRO platform as the 1TB twin with half the SSD, and a free second M.2 bay makes storage a $50 self-service fix. At the verified $2,299 CA sale price it is the cheapest route into an ISV-certified workstation in Canadian retail.
rating_notes: Ratings inferred from the 1TB twin (40.json, SKU 20069469) — identical CPU/GPU/RAM/display, storage-only delta; 512GB noted in creative_work complaints rather than rating change since second M.2 bay is free. Free second M.2 bay makes the 512GB tier a trivial upgrade
dealbreakers: Dim 1200p 60Hz panel for a creator-targeted machine
